body.message:
We would like to inform you that the quoted rate includes all utility charges, including water, electricity, Wi-Fi, DTCM fees, and VAT.

Please note that regular cleaning services are not included. However, if you require cleaning during your stay, we can arrange this for you at an additional charge per cleaning session.

For payment, you may choose from the following options:

- Visit our office and make the payment by cash.
- Complete the payment via bank transfer.
- Use our secure payment link. Please note that a 3.1% card processing fee will be added to the total amount for card payments.
